{
 "title": "Verify frame-fill transform on test input",
 "command": "cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-870789c9.py <<'PY'
from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            s=set(cells)
            if not all((r0,x) in s and (r1,x) in s for x in range(c0,c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all((y,c0) in s and (y,c1) in s for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                continue
            # These square frames are filled by parity of their interior side length.
            side = r1-r0-1
            if c1-c0-1 != side:
                continue
            fill = 7 if side % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
PY
